# EV Charging Station Nepal

> Free map directory of EV charging stations across Nepal. Find EV charging stations near me, plan highway trips, and filter AC/DC plugs.

## Site
- Homepage / map: https://evchargingstationnepal.com/
- Cities: https://evchargingstationnepal.com/cities/
- All stations: https://evchargingstationnepal.com/stations/
- FAQ: https://evchargingstationnepal.com/faq/
- About: https://evchargingstationnepal.com/about/
- Contact: https://evchargingstationnepal.com/contact/
- Privacy: https://evchargingstationnepal.com/privacy/
- Terms: https://evchargingstationnepal.com/terms/

## Primary topics
- EV charging station Nepal
- Nearest / near me EV charging stations
- EV charging station in Kathmandu and Pokhara
- NEA and Tata charging stations
- Highway corridor trip planning
- Informational notes on EV charging station cost and installation in Nepal

## Notes
- Station pages follow `/stations/{slug}/`
- City pages follow `/cities/{city}/`
- Primary language: English
- Country focus: Nepal
